notes.title: Language Update (v1.2)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30827318/f89ab745591d30151ddbc5a219ad4d48ff3acc88.jpg[/img]

[h1]New supported languages for Deserving Life![/h1]
We are pleased to announce part one of our update for supported languages.
[b]Special thanks[/b] to the translators who made this possible:

Danish - Victor Fisker
Czech - XzibitusaK
Portuguese-Brazil - Marcus Vinicius Santos
Spanish - Juan "Psycho Kurt" Buleo
Bulgarian - Todor Ilkov

[b]And even more languages are on the way![/b]

If you find any flaws or mistakes in the translations, please feel free to share your findings in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/700170/discussions/0/1482109512321271597/][b]LANGUAGES THREAD[/b][/url]. Thank you for your help!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Candle can't be taken with you down to the hallway anymore
- Fixed a bug where important objects wouldn't teleport back after leaving the playspace.
- Fixed a bug where you were able to open the gate in the basement without solving the bullet riddle.
- Some minor bug fixes

notes.title: Release Today!
notes.notes:
Deserving Life has come a long way from an initial student project to a completed Steam release.

Because of the fairly short average playtime of only 25 minutes, we have decided to provide the game [b]for free[/b].

We hope you enjoy playing it and don't hesitate to reach out to us in the BUG THREAD or create a new thread for questions and other topics.
